_readme: User-visible changes in the replacement app, newest first.

entries.summary: Tutorial: the See again step now shows the real pin flow.
detail: On the tutorial card, tapping See again fades everything but the word and its meanings and shows the same instruction as the app.
Pinning a meaning brings the card back with 'Swipe right if you know the rest.'; earlier pins are kept when the step reopens.
Tapping elsewhere on the tutorial card cancels, as on a real card.

entries.summary: Keep the login panel in place and make logout/login transitions clean.
detail: Place the loading message inside the sign-in card, with account choices and provider attribution space reserved from the start.
Reveal provider controls only after their markup and styles are ready, keeping the logo, guest button and account links stationary.
Cover logout before account cleanup and suppress intermediate provider callbacks; open the first language picker before the next paint after sign-in.

entries.summary: Pinning every meaning keeps the pins showing.
detail: The app now remembers which meanings you pinned, per word, so a card with every meaning pinned keeps its pins and count instead of going blank.
A card with every meaning missed (not pinned) still shows plain, as before.
Pins sync with your account as one small row per word in the existing account settings store; no server change.
Answering a pinned meaning correctly later removes its pin.

entries.summary: After a pin, the box says what to do next.
detail: After pinning a meaning, the box where the tiles were says 'Swipe right if you know the rest.' for a few seconds.
Pinning the last unpinned meaning says 'That’s every meaning, so the whole word will come back in Practise.' The pins still clear in that case.
Tapping the message dismisses it early.

entries.summary: 'Pin meaning' is now 'See again', with a new icon and a guided pin step.
detail: The tile is renamed 'See again' and its icon is three meaning rows with the pin pushed into the middle one.
Tapping it fades everything except the word and its meaning rows, in place, and shows 'Tap the pin on a meaning to see it again in Practise.' where the tiles were.
Pinning one meaning returns the card to normal straight away; tapping anywhere else on the card cancels without flipping it.
Row pin tooltips read 'See this meaning again'; the tutorial step is renamed to match.

entries.summary: Fix sign-in getting stuck and keep loading layouts stable on mobile and desktop.
detail: Successful sign-in opens the app without waiting for background progress or playlist sync; failed account requests can retry in place.
Reserve loading space across setup, search, music, song selection, progress and conjugation drawers; retain song checkbox focus.
Keep level and practice sections hidden while choosing Speech or Music, and ignore outdated Speech loads after switching languages.

entries.summary: About page and walkthrough: label dictionary icon, move mañana to intro, and reframe music choice.
detail: Added 'Dictionary lookup' callout and pin label in the walkthrough pointing to the dictionary tile in the bottom right corner.
Moved mañana (tomorrow) into the main intro paragraph to contrast standard speech essentials with series/music specific vocabulary.
Shortened the Speech and Music mode descriptions for direct parallelism.
Removed 'songs you love' and reframed music mode around uploading a playlist or selecting an artist.

entries.summary: About page: repeat Music subtitle beside both music features and add roncar slang contrast.
detail: Added *roncar* (to brag, not 'to snore') alongside *perreo* (reggaeton dancing) to contrast standard words given new meaning through slang vs slang-native words.
Positioned the Music subtitle in the left channel beside both music features (The slang each artist uses and Learn what things are) with scroll reveal.
Centered "What makes it different" and "How it works" in the main channel with table display matching the top title.
Formatted all bullet points under "What makes it different" equally as feature rows.

entries.summary: Flashcards: make chevron functional for collapse/expand and enable POS-wide selection.
detail: Enabled the chevron (▾/▸) on POS section headers to cleanly toggle section expand and collapse.
Tapping an open POS header activates POS-wide selection (axis: 'pos'), highlighting all sense rows and member subsenses under that part of speech.
Pooled all example sentences across all meanings belonging to that POS so learners can cycle through all usage examples.
Added sentence-attribution indicator (is-sentence-source) highlighting the exact row or subsense that provides the currently displayed example sentence.

entries.summary: Consolidate admin deck filters into a popup modal, adding Part of Speech and Jev Confidence filters.
detail: Grouped all admin setup filters into a dedicated modal opened by an Admin Filters button in the level chooser footer.
Added Part of Speech filtering (Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives, Adverbs, Function words, Other).
Added Jev Confidence & Gaps filtering (Lowest < 0.2, Marginal < 0.3, Moderate < 0.5, Unresolved gaps, High ≥ 0.8).
Trigger button features an active filter count badge; Reset button restores defaults instantly.

entries.summary: About page: replaced "What's under the hood" with a short features section, a Music mode section and a technical-details section.
detail: New "What makes it different" section: skip words you already know (with a Skipped / Kept comparison and your chosen languages), examples worth learning from, and expressions.
New "Music mode" section: each artist's slang and learning what people, places and brands are.
"How it works (technical details)" now holds the NLP detail: cognate skipping, merged forms, sentence cleaning, dictionaries, bi-encoder and Jev meaning selection.
Every Spanish word on the page now has its English meaning in brackets.

entries.summary: Highlight all subsenses immediately when selecting a grouped sense row.
detail: Clicking the sense row (whole-group selection) marks every member subsense active, immediately highlighting all subsenses.
Selecting an individual subsense continues to pin and highlight only that specific member.
Subsense groups with active members use clean spacing between highlighted items.

entries.summary: Add admin-only setup filters for single-sense words and assignment source (All / DeepSeek / Jev / No overlay).
detail: Each card is classified by its highest-priority applied overlay: Jev, then DeepSeek (at least one accepted correction), then original.
Filtering happens on the stable-ranked vocabulary before deck creation; card IDs, ranks, progress and assignments are unchanged.
Portuguese only for now; a compact card-ID index supplies the single-sense and DeepSeek lists.

entries.summary: Apply Jev assignments above the Portuguese deck for ordinary words in the first 200 cards.
detail: Use a release-pinned UI sidecar above existing DeepSeek assignments, preserving card IDs, learner progress and the published release.
Regroup all exported examples, update canonical examples and shares from the reviewed exported set, and keep unresolved decisions explicit.
Leave grammar-word cards, companion splitting and the rest of the deck unchanged.

entries.summary: Show actual merged forms on card fronts, with a Smart Skip disclosure.
detail: Use the infinitive only when it belongs to this merged group; otherwise show the most frequent member.
Place +N other forms below the front word; open a centered Merged by Smart Skip panel listing the actual group.
Keep existing lemma metadata, sense grouping, card identities and progress; verify phone and desktop layouts in both themes.

entries.summary: About & Walkthrough: centered title, subtle top and bottom app links, pure toggle walkthrough header
detail: About page: centered the top title ('The problem with most vocabulary apps') so it aligns naturally with the page layout.
About page: added subtle 'Open app →' links at the top header and at the bottom before footnotes for visitors arriving from a CV.
Walkthrough modal: streamlined top bar down to just the centered Speech/Music toggle and the close button, eliminating layout shift and visual clutter.

entries.summary: Clarify grammar-slot pills and enlarge function-word patterns and translations.
detail: Retain + before grammatical slots: saber + infinitive, começar a + infinitive and estar + adjective; literal partners such as querer que keep no extra +.
Give complement-only frames the same complete, readable phrase pill; prevent slot labels inheriting hanging indents or collapsing into inline backgrounds.
Increase function-word patterns and English meanings to 20px; make translations bold and align contraction parts beside the headword.
Verify phone and desktop rendering; leave foram and companion thresholds unchanged.
Check Portuguese DeepSeek corrections against published release data; record loading evidence for the separate WSD accuracy pass.

entries.summary: Fix Portuguese verb sense English, construction pills and linked cards.
detail: Show existential ter as to exist instead of there be; link distinct merged-lemma cards without changing progress identities.
Render tratar, procurar and começar construction frames as full-size phrase pills, preserve optional de/por, and clarify the adverb examples bem/mal.
Keep the whole ir para phrase inside its capsule; prevent compact rows clipping construction cues.
Resolve explicit expression references such as acabar de into English on the sense row, retaining the link to the full definition and example.
Verify the reported records at 320, 390 and 1440 pixel widths, plus app regression checks.

entries.summary: Restore corrected Portuguese verb meanings with verified deck loading.
detail: Fizeram shows they did; made; foram shows they went / they were, with the correct verb tables.
Verify all 10000 published cards and preserve card IDs, meaning IDs and example assignments.
Bind merge keys, frequency, dictionary examples, placement and Smart Skip assets to the corrected release; preserve the previous release for rollback.

entries.summary: Restore Portuguese decks using the previous published release.
detail: Roll back only Portuguese release paths after decks failed to load.
Keep saved progress, account data, all other languages and app changes untouched.

entries.summary: Portuguese verb forms show real inflected meanings and conjugation tables.
detail: Correct 100 grammatical-reading rows on 99 Portuguese cards; foram shows they went / they were.
Resolve the correct verb tables while preserving card and meaning IDs, example assignments and progress namespace.
Keep original dictionary grammar and correction provenance; no new lexical WSD assignments are claimed.

entries.summary: Smart Skip compares visible meanings; card links stay readable and See links open expression reference cards.
detail: Separate related forms when their displayed sense sets differ, while preserving existing merge safeguards and release consistency.
Keep linked card text at normal size with comfortable tap targets.
Generate dictionary reference cards only for explicit See links to multiword expressions, including Portuguese haver de.

entries.summary: Walkthrough: single close button, Speech/Music Example tabs without emojis, fixed header separator line
detail: Removed the duplicate text exit button, keeping just the clean '✕' close button in the top right.
Renamed segmented switcher tabs to 'Speech Example' and 'Music Example', removing emojis.
Fixed the header and subtitle height so the horizontal line separator stays in the exact same position when toggling between tabs.

entries.summary: Walkthrough: top-bar segmented switcher, no bottom bar, cleaner card header
detail: Removed the redundant summary sentence under 'This is a flashcard', giving full prominence to the card and leader lines.
Removed the bottom footer bar to reclaim ~80px of vertical space, preventing card scaling on laptops and desktops.
Added a segmented control in the top bar (Everyday Speech / Music Mode) so visitors and hirers immediately see both modes.
Next button and close button sit in the top-right header actions; arrow keys and direct tab clicks switch seamlessly.

entries.summary: About: new wording (series, playlist, everyday speech), hover tooltip on the demo cards, meanings most common first
detail: Intro: 'in real life'; learn from everyday speech, a playlist or the series you're watching; La Casa de Papel (rehenes 120th vs ~4,300th, atraco 193rd vs ~9,000th) and YHLQMDLG (perreo among the top 70).
Speech: ranked across millions of conversations in films and TV; examples from film and TV plus professionally translated sentences; mañana and todavía instead of que.
Second column is Music, about playlists rather than one artist.
Demo cards: hovering shows 'Click to see every part explained'; a click opens the walkthrough (first tap shows it on phones). The button under the cards is gone.
Demo cards list the most common meaning first (bank, then bench).

entries.summary: About page: walkthrough lines point at the right places and fit between the banners; mini cards evenly spaced
detail: About ignores the app's 'Bigger' text setting. It zoomed the page 15%, so the walkthrough's lines missed their elements and cards ran past the top and bottom banners.
Mini demo cards: rows read tick, word, bars again (a card-back rule had squashed them into odd columns).
Mini demo cards: 400px instead of 480px, content centred, so the back no longer has a big empty block under the example.

entries.summary: Grammar frames on sense rows match function-word patterns: bold connector word, coloured pill for the slot (começar: + a [inf] / por [inf])
detail: The connecting word (a, por, em, que) is bold; a slot that names a word type (inf, ger, pp, subj = verb colour; adj) is a pill in that colour, as in the function-word cards.
Frame text and the tap-for-full-wording note are unchanged; the grey phrase pill on the row in use (contar que) is unchanged.

entries.summary: About is now its own page with its own link (about.html), completely separate from the app
detail: New page: about.html. It loads no sign-in, no language, no deck and no progress, so it is the same for everyone whatever language you study or whether you use the app at all.
The walkthrough lives on that page (about.html#walkthrough).
Sidebar, Settings and Help open about.html in a new tab. Old links (#/about, #/walkthrough, ?about=) forward to it before the app loads.
The meaning-frequency bars moved into their own small module so the About page draws them without the study engine.
Service worker: About is cached under its own address and never as the app's offline page.

entries.summary: Walkthrough labels point at the right parts; demo card front matches the real card; About text up to date
detail: 'Every meaning, separated' frames the meaning rows, not just the heading; on desktop its line no longer crosses 'How often each is used'.
Demo card front: capitalised 'Noun' pill, and no dictionary form when it equals the word (as on the real card). Label now 'Noun, verb and so on, each with its own colour.'
Phone: a tag with no room above its element goes below it instead of covering it (the 'What kind of word' pill).
Spotify button gets its ring back (it was clipped).
Desktop Music screen: the card shrinks slightly instead of cutting off the last meaning row.
About: 'Tap the Spotify button and the line plays…'; footnote no longer claims a built-in French playlist.
Tutorial: the 'dictionary form' note is skipped on cards that are their own dictionary form.

entries.summary: Phones: no red outline on the open section; the folded one is a plain line
detail: The open Learn or Practise section is the only card, with an ordinary border (no red outline; none for new users either).
The folded section is one line, e.g. 'Practise · 12 waiting ›' or 'Learn · Level 1 · Words 1–100 ›', with no card around it.
